active_parameter_count_definition: materialized GPT parameters; never substitute sparse chart coordinate count
candidate_scope: accepted full-attention replacement plus the qualified fresh hidden64+24 materialized mlp.c_proj chart, with optimizer-side full-precision error feedback at decay 1.0; mlp.c_fc remains dense for causal isolation
instability_policy: hard reject NaN, Inf, divergence, failed terminal evaluation, or incomplete exact-resume state
ladder_interpretation: smallest-rung isolated terminal c_proj verification; not a fitted MLP scaling ladder
mfu_measurement_protocol: foreground real-training preflight with 1 warmup and 8 timed updates; exact Muon direction, fresh hidden64 parent and hidden24 residual selection, materialization, error feedback, native validation, and folded update execute on every measured update
monitoring_policy: PRO6 GPU0 exact-config MFU and the 238-update scientific run are foreground-polled directly; no watchdog, callback, queue worker, or heartbeat

muon_matched_givens_representation.matching_policy: fresh hidden64 fit to the current Muon direction plus prior compression residual, then fresh hidden24 fit to the exact corrected post-parent residual
muon_matched_givens_representation.scope_limit: optimizer-side trainable-coordinate geometry only; materialized checkpoint size and c_proj inference FLOPs are unchanged

optimizer_assignment_expected: dense GPT matrices use Muon; attention BlockFHT latents and ordinary scalars use AdamW fallback; mlp.c_proj uses exact Muon momentum plus fresh two-pass Givens projection and persistent compression-error feedback
prelaunch_provenance_requirements: record commit, source/config/dataset/fixed-eval hashes, literal command, host-local MFU certificate, status, log, terminal checkpoint, and exact custom optimizer state

preregistered_decision_rule.primary_metric: fixed-window validation cross entropy at update 238
preregistered_decision_rule.reject: candidate is unstable, fails the 20 percent MFU gate, or finishes above 5.5918 CE; do not combine it with c_fc error feedback
preregistered_decision_rule.pass: candidate is stable and finishes at or below 5.5918 CE; then register one combined c_fc plus c_proj error-feedback smallest-rung run

registered_resume_protocol: atomic_latest_checkpoint_v2 with full RNG state, folded Givens buffers, exact Muon momentum, and dense compression residual
selection_endpoint: terminal step-238 fixed-window validation CE against exact matched attention-only and c_proj controls
terminal_eval_protocol: evaluate at max_iters even when it does not coincide with periodic cadence
